transport.request: Send one UTF-8 JSON object followed by a newline, then read one UTF-8 JSON response line.

routing_instruction: Choose a defined function when the user's request matches one of its capabilities. If the request does not match any defined function, call display_message with a concise response or explanation instead of inventing a function name.

functions.name: screen_on
functions.explanation: Turn on the smartwatch OLED screen.

functions.name: screen_off
functions.explanation: Turn off the smartwatch OLED screen.

functions.name: display_time
functions.explanation: Show the smartwatch's current RTC time and date. Use this time as the reference when converting a relative alarm interval into a clock timestamp.

functions.name: display_message

args.name: message
args.description: Short text to show on the smartwatch OLED.

functions.explanation: Display the supplied text message on the smartwatch screen. Use this as the fallback for any user command or request that does not match one of the other defined functions; pass a concise response or explanation as message.

functions.name: set_alarm
functions.explanation: Set a daily alarm for the absolute hour:minute:second timestamp. If the user gives a time interval, first obtain the current smartwatch time with display_time, then convert the interval to a target clock timestamp, including wraparound at midnight. Pass the resulting hour, minute, and second; never pass the interval.

functions.name: display_location
functions.explanation: Get and display the smartwatch's approximate current network location.

functions.name: display_weather
functions.explanation: Get and display current weather for the smartwatch's approximate network location.
